== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes ''will'' preferentially use this on [[caster]]s.

== Notes ==
* The bonus damage begins to apply ''after'' the first damage pulse.
* Synergises with [[Psychic Instability]].
* Useful to [[cover]] other hexes that [[punish]] foes for using skills, such as [[Diversion]] or [[Shame]], forcing your target to choose between taking the damage or suffering the covered hex's effect.
** However, this skill does not cover other hexes if the target uses their own [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal skill]], since activation of the hex removal will end Wastrel's Demise, allowing the skill to remove the next hex in the [[effects monitor]].
* This skill is very effective against targets that do not use skills (e.g. [[minions]] or [[animal companion|pets]]) or rarely use them (e.g. [[The Jade Quarry]] [[Carrier Juggernaut]]s and [[Hauler Turtle]]s activate their skill, [[Carrier Defense]], under limited situations); it does the maximum damage against them and [[adjacent]] foes.
{{anomaly|If the hex is reapplied before it ends, Wastrel's Demise will continue to add up the bonus damage until the first hex would have run out. After that, the bonus damage cycle will start over.}}
{{anomaly|Unlike most [[area damage over time]] skills, Wastrel's Demise does not cause [[AI]] to [[scatter]].}}

== Trivia ==
* Wastrel's Demise and [[Savannah Heat]] are the only two skills for which [[damage over time]] increases over their [[duration]].
